questions.question: Who founded Helios Robotics?
questions.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:FOUNDED]->(o:Entity) WHERE toLower(o.name) CONTAINS 'helios' RETURN DISTINCT p.name

questions.question: In which city is Verdant Grid headquartered?
questions.cypher: MATCH (o:Entity)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(l:Location) WHERE toLower(o.name) CONTAINS 'verdant' RETURN DISTINCT l.name

questions.question: Which companies has Northwind Capital invested in?
questions.cypher: MATCH (i:Entity)-[:INVESTED_IN]->(o:Entity) WHERE toLower(i.name) CONTAINS 'northwind' RETURN DISTINCT o.name

questions.question: How many companies has Northwind Capital invested in?
questions.cypher: MATCH (i:Entity)-[:INVESTED_IN]->(o:Entity) WHERE toLower(i.name) CONTAINS 'northwind' RETURN count(DISTINCT o)

questions.question: In which city is the battery supplier of Helios Robotics located?
questions.cypher: MATCH (s:Entity)-[:SUPPLIES]->(h:Entity), (s)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(l:Location) WHERE toLower(h.name) CONTAINS 'helios' RETURN DISTINCT l.name

questions.question: Who leads the company that partners with Corvid Analytics?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Entity)-[:PARTNERS_WITH]-(o:Entity)<-[:LEADS]-(p:Person) WHERE toLower(c.name) CONTAINS 'corvid' RETURN DISTINCT p.name

questions.question: Which board member of Helios Robotics works for one of its investors?
questions.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:BOARD_MEMBER_OF]->(h:Entity), (p)-[:WORKS_FOR]->(i:Entity)-[:INVESTED_IN]->(h) WHERE toLower(h.name) CONTAINS 'helios' RETURN DISTINCT p.name

questions.question: Who founded the company that partners with the developer of GridMind?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Entity)-[:DEVELOPS]->(g:Entity), (d)-[:PARTNERS_WITH]-(c:Entity)<-[:FOUNDED]-(p:Person) WHERE toLower(g.name) CONTAINS 'gridmind' RETURN DISTINCT p.name

questions.question: Which company did the developer of GridMind acquire, and in which city is it based?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Entity)-[:DEVELOPS]->(g:Entity), (d)-[:ACQUIRED]->(k:Entity) WHERE toLower(g.name) CONTAINS 'gridmind' OPTIONAL MATCH (k)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(l:Location) RETURN DISTINCT k.name, l.name

questions.question: Which company supplies two different companies that Northwind Capital invested in?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n:Entity)-[:INVESTED_IN]->(c:Entity)<-[:SUPPLIES]-(s:Entity) WHERE toLower(n.name) CONTAINS 'northwind' WITH s, count(DISTINCT c) AS k WHERE k >= 2 RETURN s.name

questions.question: Which company works on energy storage technology?
questions.cypher: MATCH (o:Organization) WHERE toLower(coalesce(o.description,'')) CONTAINS 'batter' OR toLower(coalesce(o.description,'')) CONTAINS 'storage' RETURN DISTINCT o.name

questions.question: Which organization automates biotech laboratories with robots?
questions.cypher: MATCH (o:Organization) WHERE toLower(coalesce(o.description,'')) CONTAINS 'lab' RETURN DISTINCT o.name
